english:
Direct hits with Flux, Fusion, and Magnetic Grenades deal increased damage:
• Flux: 60% increased damage
• Fusion: 30% increased damage
• Magnetic: 22.5% increased damage overall

Only the first explosion of a Magnetic Grenade is increased by 45%.

This does not increase the <solar Solar /> effect damage of Fusion Grenades.

Kills with these Grenades spawn 4 homing Kinetic Micro-Missiles that track the closest enemy within 30 meters, dealing <pve 216 /> <pvp [?] /> Kinetic damage in a 2 meter radius on impact.

The missiles behave identically to Ancillary Ordinance's missiles.

This has a 3 second cooldown between spawns.

source.text:
Flux, Fusion, and Magnetic deal increased damage on direct hits.
Flux = 60% | Fusion = 30% | Magnetic = 22.5% total increase
Only the first Magnetic explosion gets increased by 45%.
Does not increase the Solar Effect Damage of Fusion Grenades.

Upon scoring a kill with the aforementioned grenades:
Spawns 4 homing Kinetic Micro-Missiles on the Enemy.
Micro-missiles track the closest enemy within 30 meters, dealing 216 [?] Kinetic Damage over 2 meters on impact.
They're identical in behavior to Ancillary Ordinance's missiles.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown between spawns.
